_about: Prices and conversion factors for docs/footprint.md, applied by .github/scripts/usage.py at render time to the facts in the CSVs beside this file. Each block names its source; change a number only with its source.

_sources.prices: Anthropic's published API prices (https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing), as recorded in claude-carbon's data/prices.json (https://github.com/gwittebolle/claude-carbon, _updated 2026-10-09).
_sources.claude_co2: Per-token gCO2e factors from claude-carbon's data/factors.json (https://github.com/gwittebolle/claude-carbon/blob/main/METHODOLOGY.md): a fit to the per-query energies measured for Claude 3.7 Sonnet by Jegham et al. 2025 (https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09598), Opus at 2x Sonnet, Fable at 2x Opus by list-price ratio, Haiku at 0.25x; AWS PUE 1.14 and an AWS-region grid of 0.287 kgCO2e/kWh.
_sources.claude_co2_range: Google's published median of 0.24 Wh per Gemini Apps text prompt (https://www.datacenterdynamics.com/en/news/google-median-gemini-prompt-uses-024-watt-hours-of-power-and-consumes-026ml-of-water/) applied per call gives roughly 60x less than these factors do.
_sources.actions: Cloud Carbon Footprint's Azure coefficients (https://www.cloudcarbonfootprint.org/docs/methodology): 0.78 W per vCPU idle, 3.76 W at 100%, 0.000392 kWh per GB-hour of memory, PUE 1.185; GitHub-hosted runners run on Azure.
_sources.actions_grid: a US national average, as cited in claude-carbon's METHODOLOGY.md
_sources.actions_price: GitHub's billing page (https://docs.github.com/en/billing/managing-billing-for-your-products/about-billing-for-github-actions): usage is free for public repositories on standard hosted runners; otherwise $0.006 per minute for a 2-core x64 Linux runner ($0.005 arm64), which is applied to every runner here as the lowest bound.
_sources.actions_retention: GitHub changelog, 2026-07-17 (https://github.blog/changelog/2026-07-17-actions-retention-will-cover-checks-workflow-runs-and-statuses/): from 2026-10-01 workflow runs follow the Actions retention setting, at most 90 days for a public repository.
_sources.copilot: GitHub estimates $0.05–1 of AI credits per review at Lite effort and $0.25–5 at Balanced (https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/code-review); the typed-in figure is the actual bill.
